title: smime-tree: S/MIME processor crate
description: Implement the smime-tree crate. Four synchronous operations: verify(), decrypt(), sign(), encrypt(). Key material via DecryptionKey/SigningKey traits — crate is agnostic to key location. CMS parsing via the cms crate. Handles RSA and ECDH key transport, AES content encryption, cert chain validation. Caller receives inner bytes and handles recursion.
